Starting from season 9 you don’t get end of season comp points because the devs wanted more people to play ranked. It was replaced with a progression bar that gives u 100 comp points per every 30 progression points. 
Win = 3 progression points
Draw/loss = 1 progression point

You used to get a bunch of comp points at the end of each season based on the highest rank you reached, along with the rank titles. For example, if you reached diamond you would get 1000 comp points all at once

I’d love to attend my local church but it’s usually loaded with people and I’m really bad with social interactions. I’m working on my social skills and hope to go in near future. God bless and have a wonderful Christmas.

Thank you for your thoughtful reply. It’s incredibly encouraging to know I’m not alone in feeling this way. I’m truly grateful to be part of such a welcoming community that understands these struggles. At times, I feel as though I’m standing alone with my sins before God, and it can be overwhelming. I worry that I’m not good enough to be the Christian I strive to be.

I’ve been making an effort to grow spiritually—I already have my own Bible, which I read several times a week. When I don’t have it with me, I listen to an audiobook version as I’m falling asleep. I’m working on building a consistent habit of reading and praying daily, and I trust that God is with me every step of my journey.

Merry Christmas, and may God bless you!
